field.name: Name
field.instance: Instance (needs a port: SQL Browser isn't used)
field.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved password
field.password_retype: The server, login or TLS changed, so the saved password won't be sent. Type it again.
field.save_password: Save the password in the system keychain

ssl_hint.disable: Unencrypted. Only on a network you trust.
ssl_hint.prefer: Encrypted when the server offers it; the certificate isn't checked.
ssl_hint.require: Always encrypted; the certificate isn't checked.
ssl_hint.verify-ca: Encrypted, and the certificate must chain to the CA file below; the host name isn't checked (SQL Server checks it anyway).
ssl_hint.verify-full: Encrypted; the certificate must chain to a trusted CA and name this host.

ssh.pending: Connecting through a saved SSH host arrives with the SSH lane.

error.port: The port is a whole number from 1 to 65535
